tagline: Send the invoice, then stop wondering where it went.
brief: Velure is a Nigerian-first invoicing, billing and collections workspace: send invoices, chase payment, stay compliant, and see cash flow clearly. It must read as an instrument — precise and measured — while staying premium and restrained. Not a generic invoice builder, and not another blue fintech.
criteria: Success: distinct from shields, arrows and blue fintech marks; reads at 16 px as favicon and app icon; survives one-colour print; keeps warm red #EA373E as the single accent defined in design.md.

concepts.name: Level V
concepts.idea: The initial V drawn as a spirit level: exact 60 degree arms crossed by a level line, with the form filled to that line in warm red.
rationale: Symbol and wordmark share one V geometry, so the name literally carries the mark.
Reads at 16 px: favicon, app icon and avatar all come from the same drawing.
One-colour cut keeps the level as a transparent slot, so single-ink print still works.
Warm red #EA373E stays the sole accent, exactly as design.md locks it.
Wordmark is Inter Bold at -0.032em with the V redrawn on the brand angle — outlined, never typed.

recommendation: Approved direction: A (Level V) as the symbol and C (Velure Wordmark) as the wordmark, working as one system. Concept B (Focus Rule) was explored and dropped at the checkpoint.
